text: I am deeply angry about what happened to my community after the factory closure. Over 300 families lost their primary source of income, and many are now struggling to afford basic necessities. The pain is real — I have seen neighbors who worked at that plant for twenty years standing in line at the food bank. This isn't about politics; it's about people who played by the rules and got left behind. We need concrete solutions: retraining programs, extended unemployment benefits, and investment in new industries for our region.
